item.title: 🔴 Poland busts SIM-swapping gang tied to millions in crypto theft
item.description:

item.title: 🟠 Microsoft quietly extends free Windows 10 ESU support to October 2027
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Microsoft has quietly extended its free Windows 10 Extended Security Updates (ESU) program for consumers by an additional year, allowing enrolled devices to continue receiving security updates until October 12, 2027. [...]
